summary: Unit tests for bumper.js core library are well-structured and cover major functions (parseCommits, bumpVersion, determineBump, changelog generation). However, the test suite critically fails to meet the explicit task requirement that 'ALL TESTS MUST RUN THROUGH ACT' and 'Do NOT test your script directly — all testing goes through the pipeline.' The provided tests use `node --test` directly, violating this core mandate. Missing: (1) CLI argument parsing and output tests for cli.js, (2) integration tests that run `act push` with test fixtures and capture output to act-result.txt, (3) tests validating the workflow actually executes correctly in Docker, (4) exact assertions on stdout/GITHUB_OUTPUT format. The bumper.test.js itself has good edge case coverage (breaking changes, scopes, file formats) and readable structure, but workflow.test.js only validates YAML structure/actionlint—not execution. The test suite would catch logic regressions in the library but would fail to detect workflow runtime issues or CLI integration problems. No act-result.txt artifact is generated.
